## RLumShiny 0.2.9 (Release date: 2026-08-31)

**This package version requires R \>= 4.5!**

- Add new dependency to `'jsonlite'`, which is already imported through
  `'plotly'`./

- App `sarCWOSL` (changes in parts AI supported):

  - Improve user experience through an updated GUI
  - Enable single curve inspection
  - Support rejection criteria setting
  - Support random seed fixing
  - Add interactive Abanico plot as combined output
  - Add dose table that also enables data manipulation
  - Various minor bug fixes.
